About the book

A safe, sacred space to cry out

Discover the profound truth that you are seen, known, and heard.

The God Who Hears Her is a journey into the heart of Scripture, tracing the cries and faithfulness of the women of Genesis. Each daily devotion provides a window into their lives, offering relatable wisdom, a warm embrace of comfort, and a challenge to trust in the God who intimately knows your name.

Join a chorus of voices and find a safe, sacred space to cry out.

  • Sarah
  • Hagar
  • Rebekah
  • Leah
  • Rachel
  • Dinah
  • Tamar
  • & the unnamed

Being fully seen and heard by God must have been exactly what gave her the supernatural strength and courage to walk back into that mess. Her outward circumstances didn’t change right away, but knowing she wasn’t invisible to the Creator of the universe changed how she faced them.

From “A Wilderness Theologian” — one of the devotions in your free sample

About the author

Dr. Connie Champeon

Dr. Connie Champeon is a thoughtful Bible teacher with a lifetime of ministry in Bible translation — years spent close to the words themselves, in languages far from her own, among people encountering Scripture for the first time.

She writes with depth, honesty, and a deep love for Scripture. She does not tidy the hard stories up, and she does not look away from them. What she has found in the women of Genesis—the afflicted, the overlooked, the ones who cried out—is a God who sees, and a God who hears.

— Connie
